study_status: new endpoint-family external benchmark under a locked analysis; public labels read for cleaning, not a prospective blind validation
selection_rule: include AMES, standard hERG, DILI and CYP2D6_Veith in both split regimes regardless of performance or transport gate outcomes; CYP2D6_Veith was added before its predictive comparison based only on documented sample size, because hERG and DILI calibration counts necessarily fail the frozen 100-sample gate
license_note: TDC toxicity task pages say Dataset License: Not Specified and display a CC BY 4.0 link; this does not establish blanket raw-data redistribution permission. The CYP2D6_Veith ADME page explicitly lists CC BY 4.0. Download locally with source attribution; do not commit or redistribute raw or cleaned molecule tables in this revision.

split_contract.target_selection: structure IDs/scaffold IDs only; fixed target across fit seeds; no label stratification
split_contract.scaffold_rule: order scaffold groups by SHA256(seed|scaffold_id), add a whole group only when it strictly reduces absolute deviation from ceil(0.2*n); approximate 80/20 because groups cannot be split

AMES.original_reference: Xu C et al. In silico prediction of chemical Ames mutagenicity. JCIM 52 (2012), 2840-2847.

hERG.variant_note: standard small hERG dataset, not hERG_Central and not hERG_Karim; do not import the Karim-specific 10 micromolar label rule
hERG.original_reference: Wang S et al. ADMET evaluation in drug discovery. 16. Predicting hERG blockers by combining multiple pharmacophores and machine learning approaches. Molecular Pharmaceutics 13 (2016), 2855-2866.

DILI.positive_label: drug associated with liver injury in the source benchmark
DILI.negative_label: drug assigned the non-liver-injury class in the source benchmark
DILI.original_reference: Xu Y et al. Deep learning for drug-induced liver injury. JCIM 55 (2015), 2085-2093.

CYP2D6_Veith.positive_label: CYP2D6 inhibition-positive in the TDC binary benchmark
CYP2D6_Veith.negative_label: CYP2D6 inhibition-negative in the TDC binary benchmark
CYP2D6_Veith.assay_interpretation: The source bioluminescent assay can register inhibition from inhibitors or competing substrates; benchmark-positive does not imply clinical toxicity or a uniquely established inhibition mechanism.
CYP2D6_Veith.dataset_license: CC BY 4.0 as stated on the official TDC ADME task page
CYP2D6_Veith.selection_reason: large documented sample size provides a second non-Tox21 family with sufficient calibration support for the unchanged 100-sample transport gate; selected without predictive results, not as a replacement for hERG or DILI
CYP2D6_Veith.original_reference: Veith H et al. Comprehensive characterization of cytochrome P450 isozyme selectivity across chemical libraries. Nature Biotechnology 27 (2009), 1050-1055.
